question: What kind of exciting places did the children visit in their journey? ⛰️
explanation: Great job! They went on a beautiful journey to see the tall, magical mountains covered in trees! ⛰️
hint: They are very tall and touch the clouds.

question: What covers the tops of very high mountains? ❄️
explanation: Awesome! The highest mountains are so cold that they are covered in lovely white snow! ❄️
hint: It is white, cold, and falls in winter.

question: What tall plants grow happily on the mountains? 🌲
explanation: Super! Pine trees grow very tall and look beautiful on the mountain slopes! 🌲
hint: They have needle-like leaves and stay green.

question: How do the mountains look when fluffy clouds touch them? ☁️
explanation: Fantastic! When clouds wrap around the mountain peaks, the whole place looks like magic! ✨
hint: It looks like a fairy tale.

question: What do we wear to stay warm in the chilly mountains? 🧥
explanation: Brilliant! We wear thick woollen coats to keep our bodies warm in the cold mountain air! 🧥
hint: It is made of wool and has sleeves.

question: How does the fresh air feel in the magical mountains? 🌬️
explanation: Great! The air high up in the mountains is crisp, fresh, and very cold! 🥶
hint: It makes you want to wear a sweater.

question: What sweet sound do birds make in the mountain forests? 🐦
explanation: Awesome! Little birds sit in the trees and sing sweet chirping songs all day! 🎶
hint: It sounds like a happy melody.

question: What do we pack our travel clothes in? 🧳
explanation: Super! We neatly pack all our clothes and important things in a big suitcase for the journey! 🧳
hint: It has wheels and a handle.

question: What beautiful thing flows down from the high mountains? 🌊
explanation: Fantastic! Melting snow turns into pure, clean river water that flows down the mountain! 🌊
hint: It is clear and splashes against rocks.

question: How do we feel when we see beautiful nature? 😊
explanation: Brilliant! Being in nature and looking at the wonderful mountains fills our hearts with happiness! 😊
hint: It puts a big smile on your face.

question: What fun transport can take us up a steep mountain? 🚞
explanation: Great job! A colorful toy train slowly chugs up the mountain, giving us a lovely ride! 🚞
hint: It goes chug-chug on tracks.

question: What shines brightly over the mountain peaks in the morning? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! The bright golden sun rises and shines warmly over the magical mountains! ☀️
hint: It brings daylight.

question: What sweet hot drink keeps us warm in the snow? ☕
explanation: Super! Drinking a yummy cup of hot chocolate warms us right up when it is freezing outside! ☕
hint: It is brown, sweet, and served in a mug.

question: What big animals have thick fur to live in the cold? 🐻
explanation: Fantastic! Mountain bears have thick, warm fur coats that help them live in the cold mountains! 🐻
hint: They are large and love to eat berries.

question: What covers the mountain valleys like a soft blanket? 🌿
explanation: Brilliant! The lower parts of the mountains are covered in lush, soft green grass! 🌿
hint: Animals like to graze on it.

question: How do the tall pine trees move in the wind? 🌲
explanation: Great! When the cool wind blows, the tall trees sway gently from side to side! 💃
hint: Like a slow dance.

question: What do we use to see things that are far away? 🔭
explanation: Awesome! We look through binoculars to see birds and peaks that are very far away! 🔭
hint: You hold it up to both your eyes.

question: What lights up the beautiful mountain sky at night? ⭐
explanation: Super! Away from the city, the night sky in the mountains is full of twinkling stars! ⭐
hint: They sparkle in the dark sky.

question: Where do we sleep when we camp on a mountain? ⛺
explanation: Fantastic! Setting up a cosy tent is the best way to sleep safely in nature! ⛺
hint: It is made of fabric and uses poles.

question: What is the best footwear for walking on mountain paths? 🥾
explanation: Brilliant! Strong trekking shoes keep our feet safe and help us climb the rocky paths! 🥾
hint: They have good grip for climbing.

question: What do we use to take beautiful pictures of the mountains? 📸
explanation: Great job! We click pictures with a camera to remember all the magical sights we saw! 📸
hint: It says 'click' and has a flash.

question: What colorful flying friends can we see in the valley? 🦋
explanation: Awesome! Beautiful butterflies with colorful wings flutter around the mountain flowers! 🦋
hint: They have beautiful, painted wings.

question: What do we pack for a fun picnic in the mountains? 🥪
explanation: Super! A picnic in the hills is so much fun when we share tasty snacks with our friends! 🥪
hint: Things like sandwiches and fruits.

question: How do the mountain roads look? 🛤️
explanation: Fantastic! To go up the high mountains, the roads twist and turn like a snake! 🛤️
hint: They go round and round the hill.

question: What beautiful colors fill the mountain sky at sunset? 🌅
explanation: Brilliant! As the sun goes to sleep, it paints the sky in lovely orange and pink shades! 🌅
hint: Warm and colorful hues.

question: What keeps our hands warm while playing in the snow? 🧤
explanation: Great! We wear thick woollen gloves to stop our fingers from freezing in the snow! 🧤
hint: You wear them on your hands.

question: What covers our head and ears in cold weather? 🧢
explanation: Awesome! A cosy warm cap covers our ears and head so the cold wind cannot hurt us! 🧢
hint: It fits snugly on your head.

question: What small furry animals hop around the mountain trees? 🐿️
explanation: Super! Fast and cute squirrels hop from branch to branch looking for nuts! 🐿️
hint: They have bushy tails.

question: What kind of air do we breathe in the high mountains? 🌬️
explanation: Fantastic! Away from city pollution, the mountain air is very clean, pure, and fresh! 🌬️
hint: It feels wonderful to breathe in.

question: What magical band of colors appears in the sky after rain? 🌈
explanation: Brilliant! When the sun peeks out after a mountain rain, a beautiful rainbow appears! 🌈
hint: It has seven lovely colors.

question: What soft white things fall from the sky in winter? ❄️
explanation: Great job! Pretty little snowflakes fall from the sky and cover everything in white! ❄️
hint: They melt if you catch them on your tongue.

question: How does the water from a mountain stream taste? 💧
explanation: Awesome! Natural mountain water is so clean that it tastes incredibly sweet and fresh! 💧
hint: Like cold, delicious magic.

question: What do friends do together on a mountain trip? 🎒
explanation: Super! The best part of a trip is walking on trails and exploring new places with friends! 🎒
hint: Finding new paths and taking pictures.

question: What do we use to see in the dark near our tent? 🔦
explanation: Fantastic! A bright torch helps us see our way safely when it gets dark outside! 🔦
hint: It uses batteries and lights the way.

question: What can we write in to remember our magical journey? 📔
explanation: Brilliant! Writing about our adventures in a travel diary keeps our memories safe forever! 📔
hint: A small book for your personal stories.

question: What hard brown things grow on the branches of pine trees? 🌲
explanation: Great! Pine trees drop cool brown pinecones that we can collect as souvenirs! 🌲
hint: They look like hard, woody cones.

question: What bright things grow wildly on the mountain hills? 🌼
explanation: Awesome! Wild mountain flowers bloom in yellow, pink, and purple everywhere on the hills! 🌼
hint: They smell sweet and look pretty.

question: What do we light to stay warm at a campsite? 🔥
explanation: Super! We gather around a cosy campfire to sing songs and stay warm at night! 🔥
hint: It is made with burning wood.

question: What is the best and most magical part of traveling? 🗺️
explanation: Fantastic! Going on a journey means we get to see and learn about brand new places! 🗺️
hint: Exploring the unknown.

question: What big powerful birds fly high above the mountains? 🦅
explanation: Brilliant! Eagles have very strong wings and fly way up high near the mountain peaks! 🦅
hint: They have amazing eyesight.

question: What beautiful thing falls from high rocks to make a splash? 🏞️
explanation: Great job! A waterfall looks magical as clear water tumbles down the high rocks! 🏞️
hint: Water that falls from a height.

question: What covers the very top peaks of the mountains like a white hat? 🏔️
explanation: Awesome! Because it is freezing at the top, the peaks are always crowned with ice and snow! 🏔️
hint: It stays frozen all year round.

question: What do we carry drinking water in while trekking? 🍼
explanation: Super! We must always carry a water bottle to stay hydrated while climbing the mountain! 🍼
hint: It has a tight cap so water doesn't spill.

question: How do we feel when we finally reach the top of the mountain? ⛰️
explanation: Fantastic! Climbing takes effort, so reaching the top makes us feel very proud and happy! 😇
hint: Like a champion.

question: What helpful tool shows us the right direction in the forest? 🧭
explanation: Brilliant! A compass always points North and helps us find our way if we get lost! 🧭
hint: It has a little needle that spins.

question: What soft, fluffy things float in the sky above the hills? ☁️
explanation: Great! Big fluffy clouds float in the sky like huge pieces of cotton candy! ☁️
hint: They bring rain sometimes.

question: How should we walk on narrow mountain trails? 🚶
explanation: Awesome! Mountain paths can be steep and rocky, so we must walk very carefully! 🚶
hint: Taking slow, safe steps.

question: What warm piece of clothing do we wrap around our neck? 🧣
explanation: Super! A soft woollen scarf wrapped around our neck keeps the chilly wind away! 🧣
hint: It is long and cosy.

question: What soothing sound do we hear near a mountain stream? 🌊
explanation: Fantastic! The bubbling, flowing water of the stream sounds like a peaceful song! 🌊
hint: Splish splash, bubbling sounds.

question: How can we describe a journey to the mountains? ✨
explanation: Brilliant! A trip to the mountains is an amazing adventure full of magical and fun memories! ✨
hint: It is an exciting adventure.
